test_stimuli.name: init_and_frame_output
test_stimuli.derivation: Init sequence writes all commands; frame output writes column/page address commands then data bytes. No read-back, so frame_ok sentinel ensures no error.

test_stimuli.name: frame_output_with_data
test_stimuli.derivation: Frame output writes column address range (0x21, 0x00, 0x7F), page address range (0x22, 0x00, 0x07), then data bytes. frame_ok sentinel indicates no error.
